title: Injective hypercover section rows for arbitrary Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be qcqs, A a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], U a finite split etale hypercover [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover], and F an injective A-valued small-etale sheaf. The canonical augmentation from terminal sections of F concentrated in degree zero to the alternating section cochain complex of U with coefficients F is a quasi-isomorphism. This uses the actual sectionAugmentation constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-hypercover-resolution].

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1: hypercover acyclicity on injective coefficients; Stacks Tag 01GW proof generalized by Gabriel–Popescu

proof.text: Choose the Grothendieck separator G. Gabriel–Popescu gives a faithful additive right adjoint R=Hom(G,-) to the exact tensor functor L into A, with values in modules over the opposite endomorphism ring. The induced sheaf adjunction preserves monomorphisms on the left, hence sheaf composition with R preserves injectives.
Apply the already proved arbitrary-ring module injective-row theorem to the composed injective sheaf.

The additive functor R carries both alternating section differentials and the degree-zero augmentation to the corresponding module maps. In degree zero reflect the exact augmented short complex and its monomorphism through R; in positive degrees reflect exactness of the three-term complexes. A faithful additive functor between abelian categories reflects exactness. The resulting augmented cochain map is a quasi-isomorphism in every degree.
